name: MonarchMergeDialog
title: MergeDialog
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll, MonarchRadioRow, MonarchConsequenceList, MonarchBanner, MonarchButton; presented in androidx.compose.ui.window.Dialog
summary: The content of a full-screen dialog that merges two or more duplicate records: pick the record to keep, then the value to keep for each field where they differ.
whenToUse: When the app has found duplicate records (companies, contacts, leads) and the person decides which one survives and which values it keeps.
whenNotToUse: To point out a possible duplicate before it is merged, use MonarchDuplicatePanel. To delete duplicates without keeping values, use a confirm dialog.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMergeDialog(records: List<MonarchMergeRecord>, fields: List<MonarchMergeField>, onMerge: (MonarchMergeSelection) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, defaultPrimaryId: String? = null, consequences: List<MonarchConsequence> = emptyList(), blockers: List<String> = emptyList(), merging: Boolean = false, failed: Boolean = false, onCancel: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchMergeDialogLabels = MonarchMergeDialogLabels())
class MonarchMergeRecord(id: String, title: String, description: String? = null, values: Map<String, String> = emptyMap())
data class MonarchMergeSelection(primaryId: String, mergedIds: List<String>, fields: Map<String, String>)

class MonarchMergeDialogLabels(title: String? = null, description: String? = null, keep: String? = null, kept: String? = null, values: String? = null, same: String? = null, empty: String? = null, consequences: String? = null, cancel: String? = null, error: String? = null, from: ((record: String) -> String)? = null, confirm: ((count: Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: records
options.description: The records to merge, two or more, with their field values already written for display.

options.name: fields
options.description: The fields, in display order. Those that differ get a choice; those that match are listed once.

options.name: onMerge
options.description: Called with the kept record, the merged records and, for each field, the record whose value is kept. The app runs the merge.

options.name: defaultPrimaryId
options.description: The record kept by default; the first record when null.

options.name: consequences
options.description: What else happens, shown with MonarchConsequenceList under "What happens".

options.name: blockers
options.description: Problems that stop the merge, shown in a warning MonarchBanner; the merge button is disabled.

options.name: merging
options.description: The merge runs: the merge button shows progress and the choices and Cancel are disabled.

options.name: failed
options.description: The last merge failed: a danger MonarchBanner shows labels.error (or the built-in message) and is announced; every choice stays.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Shows a Cancel button that calls it. The app closes the dialog.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the failure message.

states.name: choosing
states.description: The record choice with a Kept badge on the selected record, a choice per differing field (defaulting to the kept record's value, or the first other value when it is empty), and matching fields listed once.

states.name: blocked
states.description: With blockers, or fewer than two records, the merge button is disabled; blockers are shown in a warning banner.

states.name: merging
states.description: The merge button shows a progress indicator and is announced as Loading; the choices and Cancel are disabled.

states.name: failed
states.description: A danger banner with the message under the choices, announced politely; the choices stay as they were.

appearance: A heading and a muted description at the top, the choices in a scrolling column of MonarchRadioRows with subheadings, matching fields as muted names with default-text values, and the buttons at the bottom: Cancel as a ghost button and Merge as a primary button. Colors come from the parts' roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web MergeDialog is a modal with radio groups and a full-screen layout on phones that opens itself. On Android Monarch ships the content: the app presents it in a Material 3 Dialog with DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false) (the plan's full-screen dialog) or in a ModalBottomSheet, and closes it. The web onMerge returns a promise and the dialog waits on it; on Android the app sets merging while it runs and failed when it fails, and closes the dialog on success; iOS uses an async throwing closure instead. Values and consequences are strings and MonarchConsequence items instead of any node. The web size option has no meaning on a phone, and the web children slot is not offered. iOS uses the same name.
accessibility: Each choice is a MonarchRadioRow in a selectable group, so TalkBack reads its label, its source and its selected state.
A value option is one element that reads its value and its source, such as "hello@acme.com, from Acme Ltd"; an empty value reads "Empty".
The title, the section headings and the field names are headings; the Kept badge is hidden because the selected state already says it.
A failure is announced through a polite live region on the danger banner; while merging the merge button is announced as Loading.
Every button and row has a 48dp touch target.
edgeCases: A value that is blank after trimming counts as empty, and values equal after trimming count as matching.
Changing the kept record moves every field the person has not picked to the new record's value, or fills it from another record when it is empty.
With one record the dialog shows it and the merge button is disabled.
The merge button's count uses plurals in strings_mergedialog.xml; pass labels.confirm to write it differently.
The choices survive a configuration change; recompose with a new key to start again from the defaults.

examples.title: Two clients
A blocked merge, shown inline
examples.code:
MonarchMergeDialog(
    records = listOf(
        MonarchMergeRecord("a", "Ada Lovelace", values = mapOf("email" to "ada@example.com")),
        MonarchMergeRecord("b", "A. Lovelace", values = mapOf("email" to "ada@work.example")),
    ),
    fields = listOf(MonarchMergeField("email", "Email")),
    onMerge = {},
    blockers = listOf("A. Lovelace has an open contract."),
    onCancel = {},
)
